page.subtitle: Track user journeys and find where visitors drop off.

list.noFunnelsDesc: Create your first funnel to track visitor journeys on your website.
list.deleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

form.firstStepRequired: The first step must be required — it defines who enters this funnel.
form.lastStepRequired: The last step must be required — it is the conversion goal.
form.requiredDetail: Required: Funnel waits for this step across all pageviews. Sessions that never reach it are counted as drop-offs.
form.optionalDetail: Optional: If not matched immediately, this step is skipped and the funnel continues. Use for steps that only some users take.
form.sourceAlert: Building funnel for traffic from a specific link. Step 1 has been pre-filled — add more steps to track the conversion path.
form.noEventMatch: No events match this name yet. Ensure an Event Rule or trackEvent() call produces "{{name}}".
form.eventRulePaused: Event rule "{{name}}" is paused. Enable it in Event Rules to resume tracking.

patternTypes.page_url_help: Match against the full URL including domain
patternTypes.event_help: Match against custom event names tracked by your SDK
patternTypes.link_help: Match visitors who came from a specific short link
patternTypes.conversion_help: Match visitors who completed a lead or sale conversion

report.stateNoVisitors: No visitor data yet. This could mean no visitors have arrived, or your tracking setup needs attention.
report.stateProcessing: Your funnel data is being processed. This usually takes a few minutes.
report.stateNoMatches: No matching sessions found yet. Your funnel data updates daily overnight — if your steps look correct, new results will appear as visitors complete the funnel.
report.eventStepsWarning: This funnel includes Event steps — make sure matching Event Rules or trackEvent() calls are active.

visitors.noSessionsPeriod: No sessions reached this step in the selected period

chart.noSessionsReached: No sessions reached this step in the selected period.
chart.createEventRuleHint: or call trackEvent('{{pattern}}') in your SDK.
chart.eventRuleEnableHint: Enable it in Event Rules to start tracking.
chart.eventActiveNoMatches: Event rule "{{pattern}}" is active but hasn't detected any matches yet. Allow time for visitors to trigger it.
chart.eventRulePausedHistorical: This event rule is paused — only showing historical data.

visitorDetail.noPageviews: No pageviews recorded for this session.

hero.title: Understand How Visitors Convert
hero.desc: Funnel Analytics lets you map every step of your visitor journey, find where people drop off, and optimize for more conversions.

trackJourney.title: Track Visitor Journeys
trackJourney.desc: See exactly how visitors move through your pages from entry to conversion.

findDropOff.title: Find Drop-off Points
findDropOff.desc: Identify which steps lose the most visitors and fix them first.

visitorDrilldown.title: Visitor Drill-down
visitorDrilldown.desc: Click any funnel step to see the list of real visitors who reached or dropped off at that step.

multiStep.title: Multi-step Funnels
multiStep.desc: Build funnels with any number of steps using page URLs or custom events.
